title: Preregister the Jev demonstration-order sensitivity study
description:
## Scope

Hold selected example membership, context count, target set, task wording, and choice-option order fixed; compare canonical class grouping with deterministic interleaving, reverse order, and multiple shuffled permutations. Cross selection draw with order seed without searching for a winning order on the scoreboard. Run after the initial single-order result and before cross-model comparisons.

## Definition of done

The plan names the initial-result anchor, frozen example IDs, permutation seeds, budgets, paired contrast and interval method, request ceiling, and treatment of development versus scoreboard analysis.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-fe8852d3-4fd9-593a-a5f6-5d7cc0d84848`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
